acceptedAnswer.text: AI Discovery is the practice of making website information clear, well-structured, and accessible so search engines and AI systems can discover and interpret it.

mainEntity.name: How does AI Discovery differ from traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO focuses on helping search engines crawl, understand, and rank pages. AI Discovery builds on those foundations with explicit entities, semantic relationships, machine-readable resources, and answer-oriented content. Neither guarantees recommendations.

mainEntity.name: Which AI systems can find my content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Systems can access public content when their crawlers are permitted and the site is reachable. Access, indexing, and use depend on each provider's policies and systems; allowing a crawler does not guarantee inclusion or citation.

mainEntity.name: How do I implement structured data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Describe information that is visible on the page with accurate Schema.org JSON-LD, use stable entity identifiers, validate the JSON and markup, and keep it synchronized with page content.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between AEO and GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) emphasizes clear answers for question-driven systems. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) emphasizes the clarity and context generative search systems use to synthesize responses. Both depend on useful content and sound technical SEO.
Semantic architecture defines topics, entities, and their relationships consistently, helping people and automated systems understand what a site says and how its information is connected.
